senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; יָבַל) (cmp. בַּרְחָא, נָגוֹדָא) leader, bellwether, ram.
units: Y. Ber. IX, 13ᶜ top (ref. to קרן יובל, Josh. VI, 5) בערביא … יובלא in Arabia they call a ram yubla; R. Hash. 26ᵃ

senses.gloss: (ellipt. for קֶרֶן הַיּ׳) ram’s horn. Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 3 (ref. to Ex. XIX, 14) בשימשוך הי׳ את קולו when the horn prolongs its sound; Yalk. Ex. 281.
c. (ellipt. for שְׁנַת הַיּ׳) Jubilee, Yobel-year, the fiftieth year, the year following the succession of seven Sabbatical years (Lev. XXV, 8—16; 23—24).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 3:5">R. Hash. III, 5</cite> <he>שוה הי׳ לר״ה</he> the proclamation of the Jubilee resembles that of the New Year as to blowing &c.—

<cite ref="Arakhin 12b:12">Arakh. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>בתחלת הי׳</he> at the beginning of the Jubilee cycle; a. fr.—Pl. <he>יוֹבְלוֹת</he>. R. Hash. l. c. Arakh. l. c. <he>י״ז י׳ מנו וכ׳</he> the Israelites counted seventeen jubilee cycles from their entrance into the Holy Land to their leaving it.
